payload.title: Promote nested PF-E004 fusion
payload.decision: Promote E006 nested_conservative_grid as the primary deployment-ready surface-free candidate, retain E004 as its exact no-GR fallback, and do not create a leaderboard submission without a separate discriminating submission decision.
payload.rationale: The rule was frozen before scoring, excludes every outer fold from inner fitting, improves all five maps and all 25 outer cells, passes every registered tail and distribution-shift gate, reproduces independently, and produces raw-byte-identical local and private internet-disabled Kaggle output.
payload.revisit_trigger: A separately validated candidate or ensemble materially improves E006, hidden-test/public evidence contradicts its expected ordering, or a future runtime invalidates exact offline parity.
